title: Head‐to‐head comparison of two senolytic therapies in a mouse model of tauopathy
abstract: Tau protein accumulation induces cellular senescence in Alzheimer's disease (AD). Treating tau transgenic mice with the senolytic therapy, dasatinib plus quercetin (DQ), to clear senescent cells reduced brain pathology and improved structure and function. DQ has since been moved into clinical AD trials. Herein, we report results from a direct comparison of DQ to fisetin FIS, a senolytic with a potentially more favorable side‐effect profile.
